card.content: The HACS strategy detects the model automatically. On the manual YAML route, select **INT-14-BW** or **INT-14S-BW** under Settings - Dashboard layout.

## Settings
Model-aware controls and diagnostics. Unsupported entities are omitted by the HACS strategy instead of being shown as unknown.

cards.content: Display brightness is writable only when the integration exposes **Display Light Command**. Station sound is shown as status; a toggle is inserted automatically when a future integration version exposes a writable sound switch.
